name: print-social-story-set-black-brush-photo-frames
title: Black brush-stroke Instagram story template set
whatItIs: Four vertical story templates alternating black and white backgrounds, each using an irregular black paint-brush swipe as a placeholder photo frame with a thin gold-bordered caption box.
whatItMeans: Swapping which half is black vs white across the set keeps a minimal two-tone system from feeling monotonous over multiple stories.
techniques: alternate a two-tone background split across a template set for variety within consistency
use a raw brush-stroke mask as the image container instead of a clean rectangle
add one thin gold-line accent box to elevate an otherwise black-and-white palette
bestFor: personal blog or lifestyle story highlights

vocabulary.definition: a shape used to control which part of an underlying image or layer is visible
